alex: Heads-up — we go into the EU change window in ~2h. Quick preflight: can everyone confirm rollbacks, pins, and smoke tests? I posted the checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/change-window-checklist :eyes:

mira: db migrations pinned to v2026_04_15, rollback script at `scripts/db/rollback_to_v2026_04_14.sh`. Tested locally once. :white_check_mark:

jordan: rollback playbook updated (added explicit cache flush step) and the rollback commit is `git@repo:infra#c3f4a`. Keeping the previous model variant pinned as fallback.

sam: I can own immediate rollback on call. If latency > 300ms p90 or error rate > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes, i'll start rollback. Shout if you want a different SLO.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex at 2026-04-15T22:00Z. Canary: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> ramp. Pin applied: `release/2026-04-15-rc3`.

alex: Good. Two asks: 1) confirm release notes link + any customer-visible changes we need to flag; 2) confirm that the smoke suite covers embeddings and streaming endpoints.

mira: Release notes at https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-04-15-rc3.md — call out: changed batching defaults for /generate (may affect latency but reduces cost). I ran smoke embeddings test, looks stable.

ops-bot: Alerting: latency-p90, error-rate, and kv-cache-miss-rate monitors in the eng-slo channel. Auto-escalation to oncall if any monitor fires twice in 5m.

jordan: CI: `ci-bot` passed integration + load smoke. Load: `wrk` script ran 3m at expected qps. Logs:``
# run summary
requests: 180k
2xx: 179k
5xx: 1k
latency p90: 210ms
``

ci-bot: Canary health check enabling: health/ready -> ok. Feature-flag `new-batching` toggled on only in canary.

sam: One more: if we need an emergency extension of the freeze, who signs? Alex? For quick decision we need a senior PM + engops.

alex: I'll make the call on freeze extension, but ping @mira and @sam for rollback actions. If anything looks off at 5m into canary we abort and roll back. :thumbsup:

mira: acknowledged. I'll keep the DB watch and logs open.

sam: I'll be on standby at +1 during the window.

alex: Final: everyone OK with canary -> ramp plan and the explicit rollback triggers above? Reply with :thumbsup: or call out exceptions now.

mira: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary roll initiated at 2026-04-15T22:00:00Z. Good luck! :rocket:
